Making and eating breakfast, drinking coffee
Getting dressed in work clothes and packing bag for the shift
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient assessments, administering medication and treatments, updating clinical notes
Taking a lunch break at the hospital

Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counters
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
Taking a shower and washing up
Tidying the living room and preparing items for tomorrow's shift
